identity.resolvedIdentity: The historic main building at Eidsvoll Verk where the Constituent Assembly met and adopted the Constitution in 1814, distinct from the surrounding park, visitor centre and wider industrial landscape.
identity.identityProblem: A distant information sign shares the same name, and the protected national memorial includes park and pavilions beyond the main house. The canonical record itself names the building and must therefore anchor to the building rather than to a sign, access point or broad Eidsvoll Verk area.
identity.splitReason: The building is one coherent canonical object. The park and pavilions remain immediate context within the gameplay radius, while Eidsvoll Verk / Andelva is already a separate canonical landscape record.

evidence.finding: The official institution identifies Eidsvollsbygningen as the house where the Constitution was written and adopted in 1814 and describes the physical building as the core historic object.

evidence.reason: Confirms the exact heritage identity and broader protected context without supplying a reusable map coordinate in the captured page.
